verdict.rationale: Ashby documents a bi-directional, API-based Workday (HRIS) integration and a broad library of 250+ out-of-the-box integrations spanning 'post-hire tools,' plus webhooks for real-time data sync on candidate/offer events, which together support onboarding data hand-off. However, there is no explicit documentation of payroll-system integrations or a described offer-to-onboarding data flow that eliminates re-entry. Missing for 10: named payroll integrations (e.g., Gusto, ADP, Rippling), explicit description of offer-signed-triggers-onboarding-sync workflow, and independent confirmation the sync actually avoids re-entry in practice.
